# Dhammasaṅgaṇī-anuṭīkā (Tika Abh04t)

**ID:** Tika Abh04t
**Section:** Tīkā Dhammasaṅgaṇī-anuṭīkā (tika-abh04)
**Collection:** Tika-Abhidhamma

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Dhammasaṅgaṇī-anuṭīkā* is a Pali sub-commentary (*anuṭīkā*) belonging to the Abhidhamma sub-commentarial collection (*Tīkā-Abhidhamma*) [Gal 2003; Ronkin 2005]. In the bibliographic tradition of Pali literature, it is also identified as *Abhidhamma-anuṭīkā I* or *Līnatthavaṇṇanā I* [Nyanatusita 2008]. It functions as a secondary commentary on the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī-mūlaṭīkā*, which itself comments upon the *Atthasālinī* (the primary commentary on the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī*) [Gal 2003; Nyanatusita 2008; Ronkin 2005]. In modern scholarly studies, sections such as its *Vīsatigāthāvaṇṇanā* have been cited for their refined Abhidhamma doctrinal and semantic distinctions, such as the qualification of *ñeyya* by the word *dhamma* [Dhammajoti 2007].

**Sources**

- [Gal 2003] Noa Gal, Metaphysics of Experience. From the Buddha’s Teaching to the Abhidhamma (2003) — Identifies the text as the Dhammasaṅgaṇī sub-commentary.
- [Nyanatusita 2008] Bhikkhu Nyanatusita, Reference Table of Pali Literature (2008) — Attests alternative titles (Abhidhamma-anuṭīkā I, Līnatthavaṇṇanā I) and place in the commentarial hierarchy.
- [Ronkin 2005] Noa Ronkin, Early Buddhist Metaphysics (2005) — Identifies the text as a sub-commentary on the Dhammasaṅgaṇī.
- [Dhammajoti 2007] K. L. Dhammajoti, Sarvāstivāda Abhidharma (2007) — Cites a doctrinal passage from the Vīsatigāthāvaṇṇanā section.
